company.name: Levocred AI
company.shortDescription: Levocred AI provides an AI-native operating system that automates structured credit workflows for funds and originators.
company.description: Levocred AI provides an AI-native operating system that supports structured credit teams across the full facility lifecycle. The platform connects to loan tapes, credit agreements, servicer reports, and bank feeds to centralize data in a single workspace. It automates borrowing base reports, covenant monitoring, credit analysis, and investment committee memos. Levocred AI also generates lender packages and provides live treasury and cash visibility across facilities. The system is designed for credit funds, lenders, and originators who need audit-ready outputs and deterministic calculations. Its tools aim to replace spreadsheet-based workflows with a centralized system of record for credit operations.
